title: Stillpoint — A planetary observatory
description: An original contemplative 3D solar-system toy with eight textured planets, restrained orbital lines, procedural stars, a glowing Sun, Saturn's rings, an accessible planet catalogue and reference facts. Includes orbit/zoom, camera presets, pause/resume, speed adjustment, reset, responsive layouts and a labelled WebGL fallback.

tests.outcome: Passed; Vite 7.3.6 transformed 7 modules and bundled index.html, JavaScript and CSS in memory with write:false; exit code 0.

knownLimitations: Browser and visual interaction checks were not run because localhost browser access is unavailable in this environment.
Planet sizes, distances, orbital speeds, and surface patterns are deliberately artistic; rounded information-panel facts are for general reference.
The 3D scene requires WebGL. Without it the readable planet catalogue and facts remain available, with a clearly labelled explanation.
On narrow screens, some outer orbits may extend beyond the starting view; zoom-out and camera orbit controls support exploration.
